summary: Robo.ai Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on September 3, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing preliminary, unaudited revenue of over US$180 million for June–August 2026, primarily from its recent acquisition of Quantum Core Capital Limited completed June 15, 2026. The release notes consideration shares for the acquisition are subject to a phased, revenue-linked release mechanism as disclosed previously. This is a routine operational update and revenue disclosure, not a special-situation event. No terms, prices, premiums, or structural changes are provided. Watch for future filings on the earn-out and integration progress.
